**SPECIMEN NAME**: "Torrs Calare"  
**SPECIMEN IDENTIFICATION CODE**: 10162020  
**SPECIMEN DESCRIPTION**: Arcane Greatsword  
  
*The following section must be completed by the KREWE SUPERVISOR.*  
  
**KREWE INSTRUCTIONS**: Krewe 012 has been tasked with identifying and streamlining the arcane mechanisms displayed by specimen "Torrs Calare," identification 10162020, with a goal of replicating these mechanisms for broader Inquest utilization. Torrs Calare has been observed as being able to do the following:  
-- **Rift Manipulation**: When sufficiently powered, Torrs Calare is able to access the spectral plane associated with "rifts" and other observed holes in reality. Early experimentation with rift creation was successful but only within a small radius (within the island limits). The director would like to push beyond these limitations and seeks global rift access. The desired result is the ability to augment our own waypoints and portals with this technology, allowing travel wherever and whenever desired. And in the long term, easy and ready access to the Mists.  
-- **Arcane Fusion**: While more data is needed, Torrs Calare has also demonstrated exceptional fusion abilities. When the greatsword is properly attuned to a wielder (the director in our initial tests), it is able to fuse two separate entities of the wielder's choice. One of the captive Priory scholars hypothesized that it may have been used in the prior creation or control of the island seneschals, but without ready access following the disappearance of their "shackles," the original krewe assigned to the task is unable to replicate that data. Please note that unfusing is not possible given our current understanding, so any subjects should be considered expendable.

strings.en:
After days of digging I've finally found something of value down here that might be of intrigue to Kuda. The issue now is that I can tell the others are eying my prize. I won't let them have it! This is my chance to finally get noticed by Kuda, and I won't let them take that from me.

I've gone and locked it away somewhere they'll never find it. Even if they could, they'll never be able to get in. I've set up an uncrackable passcode. I've even gone the extra length to scatter the reminder hints of it in areas only *I* would know. Unless they have my keycard AND those fragments, they'll never get in. It's mine, all mine! I'm counting down the days until our scheduled meeting. This is it, the moment when she'll finally see that I've been what she's needed all along!

PS: Note to self, find a better way to climb those vines. I don't want to deal with another splinter up there.
